scope: Required future hosted B1 cases, not execution receipts. Mutation targets are selected structurally. Refresh dependent candidate/model/assessment hashes as specified while keeping independent caller authority fixed; failure at stale identity alone does not satisfy a deeper intended check.

cases.change: Use base/request.json and base/candidate.json separately.
cases.check: Fresh complete translation/construction; fixed claim scope and unresolved empirical function.

cases.change: Use parameter-default/request.json and candidate.json; independently authored source and supplier both declare a Duration parameter default of two seconds.
cases.check: Parameter inventory, declared type, default resolution and two-second literal timeline.

cases.change: Use parameter-override/request.json and candidate.json; default remains two seconds, explicit source and independently supplied model override is three seconds.
cases.check: Caller overrides and resolved bindings are authoritative; three-second literal timeline.

cases.change: Replace only complete base candidate.status with partial and derive its new candidate fingerprint.
cases.check: Completeness is independently reconstructed, not inferred from producer status. Preserve original construction assessment and replay it.

cases.change: Set caller constraints.require_complete=true and regenerate the candidate with the same complete implementation.
cases.check: The existing complete construction satisfies strict mode; status flags do not supply proof.

cases.change: Coherently rename source and supplier graph IDs, roles, components, templates, members, coordinate spaces and ledger identities using independently retained bijections; reconstruct all dependent authority/candidate fingerprints.
cases.check: Validate structure and independent correspondence after alpha-renaming. No fixture-ID/hash/name allowlist may implement acceptance.

cases.change: Replace the independently supplied artificial RNA root with another valid same-length RNA spelling, then reconstruct candidate bases/features and all dependent fingerprints.
cases.check: Exact reconstruction follows caller-supplied roots, not a hardcoded original base string. The result remains artificial software material.

cases.change: Derive member count and lengths independently, then set global exact_count/max_count/max_member_bases/max_total_bases and delivery-group exact_count/max_count/max_total_bases to those boundaries; reconstruct request-associated candidate and assessment identities.
cases.check: All count and size inequalities accept equality. Base has one six-symbol member; counts/lengths are reconstructed, not implementation constants.

cases.change: Individually set global max_count below reconstructed count, exact_count unequal to it, max_member_bases below the longest member, or max_total_bases below total length; refresh authority-associated candidate and assessment identities.
cases.check: Reach each material-limit check instead of stale request rejection; include base count 1 versus 0/2 and length 6 versus 5.

cases.change: Individually set delivery-group max_count below reconstructed member count, exact_count unequal to it, or max_total_bases below reconstructed total; refresh authority-associated candidate and assessment identities.
cases.check: Independently assign and count actual delivered group members, then reject the corresponding group material limit.

cases.change: Remove one retained state assignment from the candidate execution manifest while preserving original source and recomputing candidate identity.
cases.check: source_manifest_states compares every original state writer and its guard/value.

cases.change: Change a supplier Boolean and to or, refresh model/component pins and candidate references, keep original source unchanged.
cases.check: Actual operation correspondence fails even when all changed output hashes agree.

cases.change: Change the candidate/supplier typed dwell constant and refresh their identities without editing independent original source.
cases.check: Full typed parameter/value correspondence and original two-second literal timeline.

cases.change: Remove shutdown negation from the reset guard or change its ordered input references; refresh candidate-side hashes.
cases.check: Preserve original guard graph and concurrent assignment semantics; reset plus shutdown literal timeline stays recover.

cases.change: Reorder candidate model input references on an operation and refresh all claimed hashes, leaving source order fixed.
cases.check: Exact declared ordered-edge correspondence, including semantically commutative Boolean operators.

cases.change: Override only source dwell to three seconds while retaining independently supplied two-second model; regenerate request-associated candidate metadata.
cases.check: Model correspondence detects incompatible frozen source/model values; parameter parsing itself must succeed.

cases.change: Change both candidate reported dwell binding and its normalized parameter node attributes to a different supported Duration value; update candidate hashes and leave caller request fixed.
cases.check: Frozen caller binding authority, not unsupported parameter rejection, determines permitted normalized Behavior.

cases.change: Supply a non-time typed binding on the held_for duration edge.
cases.check: Typed duration compatibility; no silent scalar-unit substitution.

cases.change: Pin an execution-bearing component to a different well-formed model hash and refresh its enclosing identities.
cases.check: A component must pin the complete supplied composite Behavior it claims to execute.

cases.change: Relabel a supplier control input as an unrelated existing node; keep requested functional-control requirements empty and refresh changed authority/candidate fingerprints.
cases.check: control_input_not_causal; follow installed state-writer dependencies as well as expression inputs. Context reaches secretion through state entry.

cases.change: Bind a supplied control to a declared component that is not bound to its controlled runtime nodes or does not pin the model; keep functional-control requirements empty.
cases.check: control_material_correspondence always runs independently of requested bounded functional proofs.

cases.change: Declare two controls with the same kind/domain_id but conflicting controlling-node sets; refresh enclosing identities.
cases.check: shared_control_input_contradiction even when there are no requested functional-control proofs.

cases.change: Drop one state, rule or action from an implementation ownership binding; refresh hashes without changing original source.
cases.check: Every runtime node has a complete material implementation; hidden state/action nodes cannot escape census.

cases.change: Duplicate a selected implementation instance so a runtime source node is realized twice without a declared valid composition.
cases.check: Reconstruct source ownership and selected-instance inventory; do not simply union duplicate labels.

cases.change: Remove one required component/member placement and repair enclosing hashes.
cases.check: Many-to-many source/component/template/member/delivery coverage remains complete.

cases.change: Remove one source or material obligation from the candidate realization ledger.
cases.check: Reconstruct complete ledger from independent authority, not candidate declared completeness.

cases.change: Independently mutate product identity, quantity kind, encoding or lifecycle in candidate/supplier output contracts while retaining original circuit authority.
cases.check: All supplementary output authority is preserved alongside executable action correspondence.

cases.change: Change emitted RNA bases and recompute candidate sequence/build hashes without changing independent template root.
cases.check: Fresh independent root/template reconstruction rejects self-consistent forged bases.

cases.change: Change emitted feature span/orientation/space and recompute candidate hashes.
cases.check: Source/destination coordinates and complete required-region coverage reconstruct from root authority.

cases.change: Separately remove a required RNA member, alter nominal chemistry, or falsely mark incomplete material complete; update candidate identities.
cases.check: Complete construction and every required payload region; exact base equality alone is insufficient.

cases.change: Supply different independent request/library authority with the old candidate.
cases.check: Fresh request, source, library and construction dependency identities.

cases.change: Attach a valid wrapped source carrying deployment/acceptance authority.
cases.check: Retain wrapped_source_obligations as unresolved; do not erase the wrapper or reject only as unknown fields.

cases.change: Add a valid source implementation constraint outside the supported execution settings.
cases.check: Retain uninterpreted_implementation_constraints; no complete translation claim.

cases.change: Add a valid source ranking/preference declaration without an implemented interpretation.
cases.check: Retain uninterpreted_source_preferences; no silent dropping during normalization.

cases.change: Add valid supplementary executable input observations or input_bindings.
cases.check: Preserve supplementary input authority and report its unimplemented interpretation; not unknown-field rejection.

cases.change: Add a valid component/provider dependency requirement that the pilot cannot resolve.
cases.check: Retain provider dependency obligations; no invented provider or binding.

cases.change: Separately add valid helper, channel, construction transform or additional functional-control requirements outside the implemented pilot subset.
cases.check: Explicit capability/obligation rejection; no partial acceptance or invented material/transport.

cases.change: Attach compiled/PASS/admitted claims to an incomplete or modified candidate, preserving structural validity where possible.
cases.check: Fresh completeness and fixed claim scope; imported labels and embedded assessment cannot supply acceptance.

cases.change: Disable all producer, matcher, source-manifest builder, assembler and Python semantic-checker modules while running standalone OCaml validation of retained bytes.
cases.check: Valid retained candidate still verifies; changed-source/template negative variants still reject without consulting Python or invoking producer functions.

cases.change: Use a semantic companion trace with two simultaneous different typed assignments to one state.
cases.check: StateConflictError semantics; no declaration-order winner.

cases.change: Use a semantic companion trace with simultaneous identical typed state writes.
cases.check: Writes coalesce under shared prestate; no false conflict or sequential order dependence.

cases.change: Omit one required qualitative observation from a complete-snapshot input frame.
cases.check: Explicit missing-observation failure; missingness is not biological absence.

cases.change: Use a semantic companion state cycle with a declared bounded microstep budget.
cases.check: NonConvergenceError at the bound; no silent truncation or invented settled state.
